InLevelGameMode.name: Game mode 14: in level
summary: Runs once per frame while playing a level. Runs the message box instead if one is open; handles bonus game ending input lock, the pause toggle (Start),
and leaving the level with Select (only for levels already beaten). When not paused: sprites off-screen, scroll, layer updates, animated tiles,
ground shake, status bar, Mario, sprites, then OAM size packing.
Quirk: $00A249-$00A259 and $00A274-$00A27B are unreachable debug code (slow motion, beat level with Select).
$00A2F3: copies Mario's X/Y position to [$D1]/[$D3] (previous-frame position).

MarioGFXDMA.name: DMA Mario graphics and palette
summary: NMI-time upload. If [$0D84] != 0, DMAs 10 colors from [$0D82] to CGRAM $86 (Mario's palette). Then DMAs one tile from $7E:[$0D99] to VRAM $67F0, and Mario's
top row tiles (pointers at [$0D85]) to VRAM $6000 and bottom row (pointers at [$0D8F]) to $6100, $40 bytes each, looping while X < [$0D84]. Uses DMA channel 2.
$00A390: DMAs up to three $80-byte animated tile blocks queued in [$0D76]-[$0D80], then falls into the animated palette color write.
$00A41A: writes one animated color (A = CGRAM index, [$00] = set offset) from MorePalettes, stepped by [$14] bits 2-4.
$00A436: if [$1935] is set, clears it and DMAs $C0 bytes from $0BF6 and $0CB6 to VRAM $64A0 and $65A0.

s00A47F.name: Table: palette buffer pointers
summary: 3 bytes per entry (low, high, bank), indexed by [$0680] = 0, 3, 6: $00:0682, $00:0905, $00:0703.

MoreDMA.name: Upload queued palette records to CGRAM
summary: Reads records at the buffer selected by [$0680]: length, CGRAM address, then colors; DMAs each to CGRAM (channel 2) until a length of 0.
Then sets the fixed color via CODE_00AE47 and clears [$0680] (and [$0681]/[$0682] for buffer 0).
$00A4E3: DMA $0160 bytes from $00:0AF6 to VRAM $0750, then (unless [$13D9] = $0A) writes animated colors $6D and $7D.

s00A521.name: Table: tilemap page offsets
summary: Two 4-byte tables indexed by Y: VRAM high byte steps ($00, $04, $08, $0C) and source high byte steps ($00, $08, $10, $18).

s00A529.name: DMA tilemap pages to VRAM
summary: Probably overworld. Y = page index (0-3). DMAs $0800 bytes from $7F:4000 (or $7F:6000 if the player's submap [$1F11+x] is non-zero) + $800 * Y to VRAM $3000 + $400 * Y,
then $0800 bytes from $7E:E400 to VRAM $2000 + $400 * Y. Uses DMA channel 1.
Parameters: Y: page index.

s00A586.name: Table: DMA setup for tilemap pages
summary: Two 7-byte blocks copied to $4310-$4316: DMAP $01, B-bus $18, source $7F:4000 / $7E:E400, size $0800.

s00A594.name: Long wrapper for CODE_00AD25
summary: Sets the data bank to $00, runs CODE_00AD25 and returns with RTL. Called from bank $04.

GM04Load.name: Game mode 12: prepare level
summary: Turns off the screen and I/O, loads the level (CODE_05809E), uploads sprite graphics and palettes, sets up the scroll and tile animation,
draws Mario, copies the palette mirror $0703 to $0905 ($01F0 bytes), then increments the game mode (to $13, fade into level).
Boss rooms ([$0D9B] bit 7) use CODE_0097BC instead of the normal graphics/palette setup.
$00A5F9: pre-runs 8 steps of tile animation (CODE_05BB39 + CODE_00A390) so tiles are ready at the first frame.

Instr00A608.name: Instruction: AND #$07
summary: An AND #$07 encoded as .db $29,$07; part of the loop in CODE_00A5F9 (8 iterations).
